Is tablet 'Tech Neck' hiding 0.8 inches (2 cm) of your child's true height? 📱🦴

A 60° forward neck tilt places up to 60 lbs of shear load on the cervical spine, compressing intervertebral discs and rounding the thoracic back.

✅ Try the 3-Minute Evening Decompression Routine:
• 3 sets × 30-second Doorway Pull-Up Bar Dead Hangs before bed
• Eye-level book & tablet stand (35°–45° angle)
